from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Literal, Optional

class DocumentAnalysis(BaseModel):
    """Captures the classification-relevant facts from a single judgment document."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the judgment document, e.g., '判决文书1'")
    case_domain: Literal["Criminal", "Administrative", "Civil"] | None = Field(description="The broad legal domain of the case")
    administrative_subtype: Optional[Literal["Expropriation", "Compensation", "Payment", "Revocation", "Inspection", "Special Procedure"]] = Field(description="Specific administrative action category if the case is administrative")
    civil_dispute_subtype: Optional[Literal["Contract", "Others"]] = Field(description="Civil dispute category if the case is civil")
    criminal_charge_subtype: Optional[Literal["Property Crime", "Others"]] = Field(description="Criminal charge category if the case is criminal")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Container for the collection of extracted document analyses."""
    documents: list[DocumentAnalysis]
